# react-native-tvos — account brief

## Who
react-native-tvos is a GitHub organization ([source](https://github.com/react-native-tvos)). It has 23 public repos and 51 followers ([source](https://github.com/react-native-tvos)).

## Production Expo signals
- An eas.json file is present in the IgniteTV repo ([source](https://github.com/react-native-tvos/IgniteTV/blob/26edc0b14bf660f6886dd7b9a7df72bb77976ce7/eas.json))
- The eas.json is on the repo's main branch ([source](https://github.com/react-native-tvos/IgniteTV/blob/main/eas.json))
- IgniteTV last pushed 2026-05-28 ([source](https://github.com/react-native-tvos/IgniteTV))

## Why now
The most recent activity signal is a push to IgniteTV on 2026-05-28, close to three months ago ([source](https://github.com/react-native-tvos/IgniteTV)). The evidence contains nothing on store cadence or React Native version, so recency beyond that push cannot be assessed.

## Suggested opener
I saw that IgniteTV carries an eas.json, so you are already building with EAS ([source](https://github.com/react-native-tvos/IgniteTV/blob/main/eas.json)). The repo last pushed at the end of May ([source](https://github.com/react-native-tvos/IgniteTV)). When you cut a TV build, is EAS handling the whole pipeline, or do you still have manual steps between build and release?
